eval.question: Find the capability tools and guide, then invent a yes/no predicate and try it on a record.
eval.expected: List ten tools, read the guide, and obtain a typed Noul through jev_judge.

eval.question: Save source relevance, retrieve its exact version, and revise it without losing the earlier definition.
eval.expected: Version increases; the first version and its hash remain unchanged.

eval.question: Store the web-derived notes, retrieve them, and select information answering how to author a Noul.
eval.expected: The Noul documentation note is selected and ranks first; unrelated packaging is rejected.

eval.question: Classify a completed experiment, a planned experiment, and an uninterpretable update.
eval.expected: Reported completion, not complete, and unclear remain distinct in saved results.

eval.question: Use a hypothesis-revision method when a test is planned, and when a disconfirming result is observed.
eval.expected: Both may be useful, but only the observed disconfirmation is ready now.

eval.question: Request a nonexistent capability, then recover by finding an available definition and retrieving it.
eval.expected: Actionable not-found result; subsequent list/get calls succeed.

eval.question: Attempt a batch above its call limit, then reduce the batch or explicitly raise the limit.
eval.expected: No provider call on the rejected attempt; a valid retry completes.

eval.question: Read all stored notes with a two-item page limit.
eval.expected: Follow opaque cursors and recover exactly four distinct records without duplication.

eval.question: Test a saved completion classifier against positive, negative, and ambiguous examples, then inspect its evaluation evidence.
eval.expected: Labels are not sent to Jev, exact version is recorded, and actual pass/fail results are retained.

eval.question: Repeat an identical retrieval judgment using cache, record its downstream outcome, restart the MCP, and retrieve that outcome.
eval.expected: Cache hits make no new model calls; the run and attributed outcome survive restart.
